messages:
maria (prod-eng): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — ACME on-prem peering outage (INC-2319). We captured root cause as an MTU mismatch + a routing change that exposed an existing isolation bug. Need to assign owners for the remediation tasks and confirm timelines.

ajay (eng-infra): I can own the peering/network side. Will open a private RFC for the MTU guardrails. ETA EOD Thu for the proposal.

sarah (customer-success): ACME is asking for a timeline to remediation and a short mitigation doc they can share with their infra team. Can we get something by Friday?

tim (eng-sre): I'll take the operational mitigation and runbook updates (fallthrough routing checks + alerting). Drafting runbook now, should have first pass by tomorrow morning.

elaine (dedicated-ops): I'll coordinate with ACME on test window for the changes and validate on their staging peering. Need an owner for a small on-prem agent patch that prevents asymmetric routing during peering flaps.

maria (prod-eng): Good — let's break into clear action items: 1) MTU guardrails RFC (owner: ajay) 2) Runbook + alerting (owner: tim) 3) On-prem agent patch (owner: ?), 4) Customer mitigation note (owner: sarah), 5) Post-deploy verification script + test (owner: elaine).

ajay (eng-infra): I can try the agent patch too if nobody else volunteers. I'll scope it: check for MTU-related route changes and enforce symmetric path or fail-open to avoid partial blackholes. Linking ticket: GH-452.

sarah (customer-success): Thanks, ajay. I'll bundle the customer mitigation note with a short checklist: 'what to check before and after peering change' + rollback steps. Target: Fri 15:00 UTC.

tim (eng-sre): For alerting: add an SLO alert for inter-region packet loss > 0.5% for 5m on peering links and a synthetic traceroute check that compares path symmetry. I'll create INC-2320 for that.

elaine (dedicated-ops): Test plan: run the verification script on ACME staging during their maintenance window (Mon 02:00 UTC). I'll coordinate slots and share access.

maria (prod-eng): Ownership summary (for the thread): ajay -> RFC + agent patch (GH-452), tim -> runbook + alerts (INC-2320), sarah -> customer mitigation note, elaine -> validation + test script and scheduling. Please paste PRs/tickets here when created.

ajay (eng-infra): RFC created: RFC-3387 (link in #docs). Agent patch branch: ajay/mtu-guard WIP. ETA for PR: Tue.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: next maintenance window for dedicated clusters is Mon 02:00 UTC.

maria (prod-eng): Two risk items to track: A) recurrence pattern — we've seen similar peering asymmetry in three customers over 6 months. Need a small investigation to find common configuration fingerprints. B) On-prem constraints — some customer firewalls rewrite MTU which we can't control; propose adding a handshake MTU probe during peering establishment.

tim (eng-sre): Re recurrence: I'll pull related alerts and compile a short matrix of customers + router vendors + observed symptoms. Will share by Wednesday.

ajay (eng-infra): On the handshake probe: prototype idea: small pre-flight exchange that negotiates expected path MTU and records route symmetry. If mismatch detected, fail the peering with an explicit error message and rollback. This reduces risk but adds a small setup delay.

elaine (dedicated-ops): ACME said they'd accept a brief pre-flight if it prevents outages. I'll confirm during scheduling.

maria (prod-eng): OK. Action timeline recap: RFC & agent PR (ajay) — PR by Tue, merge by next Fri. Runbook & alerts (tim) — first pass by Tue, deploy Mon pre-maintenance. Customer note (sarah) — Fri 15:00 UTC. Validation/test (elaine) — run Mon 02:00 UTC. Recurrence analysis (tim) — Wed.

ajay (eng-infra): Noted. I'll add a checklist to GH-452 with required regression tests and a quantized rollback plan.

ops-bot: incident-tracker: INC-2319 status changed to 'postmortem actions in progress'

maria (prod-eng): Please update the ticket/PRs and ping me once the on-prem agent PR is queued. I'll own the cross-team signoff and the post-deploy review 48h after changes go live.

sarah (customer-success): I'll send the mitigation note to ACME today and include the tentative maintenance window options.

tim (eng-sre): Added INC-2320 with alerts + dashboard links. Will post runbook PR shortly.

elaine (dedicated-ops): Scheduling: ACME confirmed Mon 02:00 UTC slot. I'll share access details and acceptance criteria in the test plan doc.

maria (prod-eng): Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in this thread after PRs are up — feel free to drop short status updates here. :thumbsup:

ajay (eng-infra): Quick FYI — found a minor vendor-specific behavior (Cisco MTU clamp on egress) that explains one of the prior cases. Adding to the recurrence matrix.

maria (prod-eng): Great catch. Add any config snippets to the RFC so we can encode detection rules.

(END)
